annotations.text:
great_cto board — design specification under direction ①

Sibling of the landing spec: same rules, dark ground, dark accent.
Zero radius, mono voice, no shadow.

Closes the two findings the first board spec left open: the gate
decision surface was never specified, and gate weight did not follow
cost-of-undo.

Orientation on Supabase is behavioural — dense craft, not palette.
